entities.name: Ribosome-binding factor A
observations: The 128-aa query is an exact full-length match to reviewed UniProt Q5QTY9; sequence annotation assigns RbfA a role in 30S ribosomal subunit maturation and efficient 16S rRNA processing.
Pfam RBFA (PF02033.24) detected at residues 7–110; reference annotation places the protein in cytoplasm and reports small ribosomal subunit binding.

entities.name: 30S subunit maturation
observations: RbfA associates with free 30S subunits and is required for efficient 16S rRNA processing during late maturation of the small ribosomal subunit.
